relationships.history: Andre heard one of his beats through the wall of the Copper Tap's storeroom and gave him the studio's late slot. Kai would walk into traffic for him.
Cousins: their mothers are sisters in Atlanta. Theo needed a room and a fresh start; Kai had both.
His boss at the Copper Tap for a month. He quit mid-shift on a Friday to finish a beat, and still owes her an apology.
Sol sings over his beats at the open mic and won't let him play anything unfinished.

memories.info: The night Andre handed him the keys to Low End Studios' B room.
Walked out of a Friday shift at the Copper Tap with the bar three deep.

profile.tagline: Makes beats in the B room. Makes them louder after midnight.

appearance.face: square face, wide nose, full lips, stubble
appearance.hair: black shoulder-length locs under a black baseball cap
appearance.style: red zip-up hoodie over a white tee, baggy black cargo jeans, plain red-and-white high-top sneakers
appearance.jewelry: a silver chain necklace, pierced ears
appearance.silhouette: an oversized red hoodie over a long, lean frame
key_features: Pierced ears and a chain necklace

profile.family_background: Raised in southwest Atlanta by his mother, a MARTA bus driver, with three sisters and one pair of headphones between them.
profile.education: High school diploma; YouTube for everything after
goals: Get a beat on Andre's next record
Play his own set at ÉCLAT's opening
ambitions: A record deal that doesn't own his masters
profile.social_preferences: Loud rooms, late nights, and one person who'll tell him a beat is bad.

secrets.truth: He found the original session for Andre's 'Golden Hour' on the studio drive. The sample isn't cleared, and he hasn't told anyone he knows.

thursday.activity: Open mic at The Copper Tap

social_media.bio: beats from the B room. livéra.

life_history: Sold his first beat at sixteen for forty dollars.
Came to Livéra for a barback job and a cousin's spare room.
Quit the Copper Tap the week Andre gave him studio time.
